algorithm.note: One episode is a run of neighboring rolling starts of the same direction that all hit the TP inside the frozen horizon. This approximates distinct excursions better than overlapping window hits, but it is still window-based (not unique first-touch timestamps). No extra cooldown was introduced.

corpus_split.new_holdout_rule: Last 2 full later UTC days (eligible hours >= 23.0) plus any later dates on/after that anchor. Not applied when fewer than 2 full later days exist.
corpus_split.note: v1 OOS dates stay untouched. Later verified COMPLETED windows are expanded discovery unless a predeclared full-day holdout exists. No price-path statistics entered this decision. Do not use OOS or holdout to choose horizon/TP.
